name: Only One ~Minano Sensei no Poolside Lesson~
original_name: オンリーワン～美奈乃先生のプールサイドレッスン～
source:
Main character belongs to a swimming club. He is asked to give special training to his childhood friend from the same club. However, protagonist involuntarily trespasses skinship boundaries and insults the girl. The training sessions continue, but with a different emphasis.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公属于游泳部。有人请他为同属游泳部的青梅竹马进行特别训练。然而，主人公无意间越过了亲密接触的界限，冒犯了女孩。训练仍在继续，只是重点已经不同。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
